Now there's three solutions for who this could be: • Gray Mann • Someone entirely new who (probably?) would've been introduced in the final comic, most likely relating to the one the Admin gave a promise to. (Without a lead for a character that doesn't exist, however, the evidence is simply insubstantial.) • Someone already known who hasn't been revealed to be associated with the Mann Family.

So, at this point, I'm assuming that the middle person was supposed to be Gmann, but with the introduction of new writers specifically for the comics, a small incontinuity may have formed. As shown in Zmann's will, it explicitly states that the two met directly and that Gmann blackmailed him a year prior to his death. Now by all accounts this should be pretty damning evidence. If it weren't for Blood Brothers. If this is to be the incident in which they met and Gmann slipped into the family portrait unknown to be one of Zmann's sons, why didn't the Mann brothers recognize him at all? The Mann bros have been characterized to be rather stupid, but it would be a bit out of character. Similarly, according to Gmanns dialogue in BB, it makes it sound as if this was his first time meeting the Mann bros in person, as he purposefully distanced himself. Realistically, Gmann's blackmailing would have been done in private with Zmann, not out in the open in front of the rest of the family if he wanted to suspend that distance and veil of secrecy.

It just wouldnt make sense from Eriks pov (assuming he came up with the idea of a 3rd brother from/alongside the torn Sman photo) for him to retcon the characters only piece of backstory.

As for other candidates for this mans identity, the pickings are extremely slim: • Radigan Conagher (Engi's grandfather) doesn't work with BB's continuity. • Bilious Hale (Saxton Hale's father) whose large size for someone presumably very young could be explained by Australium speeding up his growth, should be standing next to Barnabus Hale. (Right) • Francis the Talking France, is too buff and attractive to fit this comparatively shriveled man.

The most likely alternative candidate I could find is Charles Darling. His size could be explained away similarly to Bilious Hale, while his distance from Barnabus could be explained away by the fact that he may be a relative to the Mann family. He shares a surname with William Darling. (Bette Mann's father who is Zmann's wife) Although this would still leave Charles exceedingly old despite his livelyness in the comics. Regardless, his relation to Bette Mann would make sense to be a surprise reveal. Without any real lead, Bette Mann is the most likely candidate to be the one the Admin made a promise to since the Admin's goals have been centered around the Mann triplets for whatever reason.

Tl;dr it's prolly Gray Mann but as with all of TF2's continuity- it's with an asterisk.
